articles.title: Minecraft Just Opened a Door to a Whole New World
articles.summary: Minecraft Live just showed off a brand-new dimension called The Sift — the first new world in 15 years! It has blue bunnies. There are also underground ice caves and a Switch 2 version coming October 27.

articles.title: It's Fat Bear Week! Time to Vote for the Chubbiest Champ
articles.summary: Fat Bear Week is back! Until September 29, people around the world vote online for the fattest brown bear in Alaska's Katmai National Park. One bear named Chunk is back to defend his title after recovering from a broken jaw.

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo's Tour Opened With Flowers, Rain, and a Dress That Melted
articles.summary: Olivia Rodrigo kicked off her Unraveled Tour in Hartford, Connecticut on September 25. The show had pink flowers everywhere, falling rain and snow, and a dress that dissolved on stage. She also led the crowd in singing Happy Birthday to her mom.
